content.content: When an open draft is discarded, the deccy CLI shall: remove the record's document — the one document at the path its handle names, `.deccy/work/<handle>.json`; leave every other record at its handle, rewriting, renaming or removing no other document; never remove a landed record, removal being confined to a draft that did not land; and leave the removed record absent, absence being no third state beside open and landed.
content.rationale:
The prerequisite fixes the store's removal in prose, and this node writes that one commitment in the requirement form without adding an element to it. The trigger names the only subject either prerequisite allows — an open draft being discarded — and each clause of the response reads a boundary one of them already draws.

The removal clause is the store's removal stated as the event's outcome: the filename is the handle, so the path is the handle's and the removal takes that one document at `.deccy/work/<handle>.json` and nothing else. The sentence does not say how the handle is minted or what it looks like beyond the path form the prerequisite already fixes, nor what fields the removed document carried.

The retention clause is the removal read across the directory: every other record has its own key, so it has its own path and cannot be the one the discard names; the directory shrinks by exactly the discarded document, and no second document is rewritten, renamed or removed. It does not say how the directory is scanned, listed or indexed, or how a write to any remaining document is made.

The landed-end clause is the same lifetime read at the other end: discard names a draft that never landed, and retention keeps a landed record at its handle, so removal never reaches the landed end — nothing is taken away at landing or after it. The clause does not settle what a landing writes or how the landed record is later reversed.

The absence clause is the outcome in the state vocabulary: the store no longer holds the record, and the two states still exhaust the landing question, so absence is not a further condition and not a return from the landed end. The sentence adds no third state and no transition; it reports that there is none.

Deliberately outside, because each is another commitment: the verb surface — the command, its name, flags, arguments, output, refusal wording and exit status; the workspace and change mechanics of a discarded draft, whether or how its jj change is abandoned or its workspace forgotten; the record's field set, version and serialization; how a handle is minted; and the atomicity, durability and concurrent-writer behaviour of the removal. A discard can remove its record's document with none of these settled, and settling any of them would not change this sentence.

The sentence carries no verdict and no evidence: it states what a discard takes out of the store and what it leaves, and whether a particular discard did so is a finding about a run, not content of this decision.
